show.description: “Billionaire Ka MMS” is a gripping corporate thriller that unfolds in real time on the day before a billion-dollar IPO. At the heart of it stands Neel Pradhan, a brilliant but broken fintech CEO whose arrogance, trauma, and moral decay spiral into chaos when a scandalous MMS from his past surfaces during his live IPO announcement.
